## src/world_engine/

- `__init__.py` — World Engine — local, single-player-first RPG world engine.
- `analyzer.py` — Conversation analysis — extract proposed mutations from unanalyzed turns.
- `analyzer_transcript.py` — Conversation-agnostic analysis core (TICKET-0051, BRIEF-0051-c).
- `condition_forms.py` — The requirement forms: the leaves of the condition language, each with its evaluator (TICKET-0111, BRIEF-0111-A -- a pure move out of `day_plan.py`, which keeps the plan emission and the budget cut; decisions S1 of TICKET-0075, C-01 of TICKET-0108, G1 of TICKET-0110 unchanged).
- `condition_interpreter.py` — The condition interpreter: a sentence in French -> a condition tree the creator confirms (TICKET-0112, BRIEF-0112-C; decisions A1 and T1 of the conditions series, IA1-IK1 of TICKET-0112).
- `condition_text.py` — A condition in French, for the creator and the player (TICKET-0111, BRIEF-0111-B, decision T1).
- `conditions.py` — The condition language (TICKET-0111, BRIEF-0111-B, decisions A1, I1, P1, R1 and S1 of the series).
- `context.py` — NPC context assembly — the engine's structural control over what an NPC may say.
- `context_describe.py` — Descriptive NPC/MJ context helpers (TICKET-0091 BRIEF-B move; BRIEF-G switched them to facts).
- `context_window.py` — Sliding context window — shared seam for the played and observed lanes (TICKET-0050, BRIEF-0050-a/-b/-d; TICKET-0052, B1/I2).
- `day_choice.py` — Model choice among narrowed candidates (TICKET-0094, H2).
- `day_concordance.py` — Concordance and germ emission (TICKET-0075, BRIEF-0075-c — decision C1: **the resolver never authors**; robustness and casting, TICKET-0081, BRIEF-0081-a — decisions G2, C2-partition, F1, E2c).
- `day_extract.py` — Day-declaration extraction passes (TICKET-0075, BRIEF-0075-c — the extraction-and-concordance step; decision C1: the resolver never authors).
- `day_feasibility.py` — The feasibility veto (TICKET-0075, BRIEF-0075-g — decision Y1).
- `day_mutations.py` — Mutation emission for the resolved day chain (TICKET-0075, BRIEF-0075-e, as corrected by BRIEF-0075-e-amendment-1 and BRIEF-0075-d-amendment-1 / V1).
- `day_narration.py` — Narration and the conditional rewrite (TICKET-0075, BRIEF-0075-d, Scope IN items 3-4).
- `day_narration_guard.py` — The T1 judge for day narration (TICKET-0075, BRIEF-0075-d, Scope IN item 4).
- `day_plan.py` — Day-plan emission and budget cut (TICKET-0075, BRIEF-0075-b — the plan-emission-and-budget step; decisions F1, M1, P2, S1, H1).
- `day_plan_select.py` — Plan-selection pass (TICKET-0077, BRIEF-0077-c).
- `day_plans.py` — Open-plan reads and the park/activate transition (TICKET-0077, BRIEF-0077-a).
- `day_reconcile.py` — Reconciliation pass (TICKET-0075, BRIEF-0075-f — decision R1; Z4 and AA2 correcting the original brief, per AMENDMENT 1).
- `day_resolve.py` — Step resolution and the frozen fact sheet (TICKET-0075, BRIEF-0075-d — decisions B4-as-amended and T1; dice are Python, never a model — as corrected by BRIEF-0075-d-amendment-1, decision V1).
- `day_rewrite.py` — The declaration rewrite (TICKET-0081, BRIEF-0081-b — decisions A2'/B2/J2).
- `db.py` — Database engine and session management.
- `debt_reads.py` — Debts: what the two surfaces read (TICKET-0110, BRIEF-0110-B, contract C-06).
- `encounters.py` — Encounter registry writer and reads (TICKET-0091, BRIEF-0091-C, C-07).
- `entity_author.py` — AI entity-authoring assistant (NPC, Location) — BRIEF-24, BRIEF-25.
- `event_author.py` — AI event/agenda-authoring assistant — extracted from `entity_author.py` (TICKET-0028, BRIEF-0028-d, decision H1).
- `facet_reads.py` — Facet reads (TICKET-0091, BRIEF-0091-D, C-10): one call to read what is said of an entity, facet by facet.
- `facets.py` — The facet registry (TICKET-0091, BRIEF-0091-A, contract C-01).
- `fact_refs.py` — Fact references (TICKET-0097): how a model names a fact, and how the mutation pipeline tells two knowledge proposals apart.
- `fact_versions.py` — The version of a fact someone knows (TICKET-0105, BRIEF-0105-C, C-05).
- `gathering.py` — Initial NPC clustering when a player enters a location (schema v1.8, Tier 1).
- `geometry.py` — Pure collision geometry for the spatial workstream (TICKET-0030, BRIEF-0030-a).
- `holdings.py` — Who holds how many of an item (TICKET-0109, BRIEF-0109-A, A1).
- `knowledge_resolve.py` — Scoped default knowledge-level resolution (TICKET-0082, BRIEF-0082-c, G2a), dated by contact (TICKET-0105, BRIEF-0105-D, B5).
- `ledger.py` — Read helpers for the `ledger` table (BRIEF-18).
- `link_author.py` — NPC link agent — roster resolution, pair-pass orchestration, coherence pass, and journal substrate (TICKET-0036, BRIEF-0036-a/b/c).
- `link_context.py` — NPC link agent — coherence-pass serialization (TICKET-0036, BRIEF-0036-c).
- `link_sheet.py` — Link-agent NPC sheet rendering (TICKET-0091 BRIEF-B, pure move).
- `llm_parse.py` — Single chokepoint for parsing local-model JSON output (TICKET-0027 R2, BRIEF-0027-e).
- `lore_candidates.py` — Candidate enrichment for the lore consultation surface's disambiguation round-trip (TICKET-0085, BRIEF-0085-c).
- `lore_choices_read.py` — Reads for the model-choice review (TICKET-0095, K1, C-05/C-06): the choices of the active world that wait for Nia's verdict (E2, J1), what the model cited and where it came from, and the scope K1 proposes for an appellation (C2).
- `lore_mentions_read.py` — Reads for the name-resolution panel (TICKET-0091, BRIEF-0091-K, contract C-16, decision Q17d).
- `lore_plan.py` — The model reads the question and names selectors.
- `lore_prompt.py` — Prompt resolution for the lore consultation chantier (TICKET-0085, BRIEF-0085-d).
